record.title: Maxim Konsevitch
record.name: MaximKonsevitch
record.content:
{\bf Dr. Maxim Konsevitch} (b. on August 25th, 1964 in Khimki, Russia), French mathematician since 1999, currently Permanent Professor at IHES, who received the Fields Medal in 1995 and the Crafoord Proze in 2008.
His PhD is from the University of Bonn in March 1992.
subsections{Academic and Research Positions:} \begin{itemize}
\item 1985--90, Young researcher at the Insitute for Informatics Problems in Moscow
\item December 1988, Visiting the ``Centre de Physique Th\'eorique'', Marseille-Luminy
\item March--June 1990, Visiting the Max-Planck-Institut f\"ur Mathematik, Bonn
\item January--November 1991, at the Max-Planck-Institut f\"ur Mathematik, Bonn
\item November 1991--January 1992, Visiting Harvard University, USA
\item February--September 1992, Visiting the Max-Planck-Institut f\"ur Mathematik, Bonn
\item octobre 1992-mars 1993, Visiting the Institute for Advanced Study, in Princeton, USA
\item April 1993--August 1994, visiteur au Max-Planck-Institut f\"ur Mathematik, Bonn
\item July 1993-- August 1995, Professor at the University of California at Berkeley
\item Since September 1995, \PMlinkexternal{Permanent Professor at l'Institut des Hautes \'Etudes Scientifiques (IHES)}{http://www.ihes.fr/~maxim/CVFrancais.htm}, \PMlinkexternal{AXA Chair for Mathematics}{http://www.ihes.fr/jsp/site/Portal.jsp?page_id=288#}
\item Since November 1997, Professor of a Special Chair at Rutgers University, New Brunswick, USA, one month each year
